info.name: Inworld LLM Router Chat Completions API

items.docs: OpenAI-compatible chat completions. The `model` field accepts a specific model id, a `provider/model` id (e.g. `openai/gpt-4o`), `auto` for the router's default selection, or `inworld/<router-name>` to invoke a named router. Anthropic-compatible request shapes are supported via the Anthropic-compat header set documented at `/router/anthropic-compatibility`.
List models available via the Router and first-party Inworld services.
